summary: Framework-free REST/OpenAPI boundary foundations for messenger, mail, social, and community write paths, layered over the domain/API/usecase foundation slices.
claim_boundary: Framework-free REST route/handler foundation only; no Hyper/h3 runtime binding, no full OpenAPI route coverage, no AsyncAPI/proto parity, no persistence, no deployed endpoint, no SLO attainment, no production or hyperscaler maturity claim.

facets.F1_simplicity: REST crates contain route constants, header-shaped contexts, request/response structs, and handler functions only; no framework or I/O dependencies.
facets.F2_hyperscaler: Honest non-claim: hyperscaler grade remains pending until full route coverage, runtime, telemetry, SLO, rollback, CI/CD, branch-protection, and promotion evidence exist.
facets.F3_adversarial: Tests cover route constants, missing idempotency, missing tenant scope, DMARC hard reject through usecase, work social consent refusal, community principal-bound voting, and moderation evidence refusal.
facets.F5_quality: cargo test, clippy -D warnings, and cargo fmt --check pass for all touched domain/API/usecase/REST packages.
facets.F7_security_privacy: REST boundary preserves tenant/context/idempotency/audit-correlation checks before usecase execution and does not expose plaintext or provider/runtime details.
facets.F11_observability: Request IDs are carried as audit correlation IDs for future OTel/runtime emission; no runtime emission claim.
